Given a stable price near $70, a strong balance sheet and cash generation, and no adverse news, I judged a modest starter position appropriate and bought 71 shares at a limit of $70.10 — just above the ask, so it filled immediately at $70.10 for roughly $4,977, keeping the position small relative to the $10,000 daily budget and leaving room to add after the upcoming earnings release. Key figures relied on: FY2024 revenue $642,637M, net income $15,511M, diluted EPS $1.91, operating income $27,012M, operating cash flow $35,726M.
